content.text: my ctrl-shit-p command palette is not working?
I’ll trace Ctrl+Shift+P through the terminal and Zellij bindings, then check the command-palette launcher for failures.

questions.title: What happens when you press Ctrl+Shift+P?
options: The palette opens, but commands fail

content.text: I found that the palette exits immediately because its “already open” lock is held. I’ll check which process holds it and fix the launcher so commands started from the palette release that lock.

An old palette in `bookcreator-node-api-translate` has held the global lock for over two hours. That blocks the shortcut in every session. I’ll scope the lock to each session and release it when you select a command.

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/thom/src/github.com/tteggel/.dotfiles/scripts/command-palette.sh
@@
-# Prevent multiple palette instances
-exec 9>/tmp/command-palette.lock
+# Prevent duplicate menus within a session without blocking other sessions.
+# Hash session names so they cannot introduce path separators in the lock path.
+session_key=$(printf '%s' "${ZELLIJ_SESSION_NAME:-standalone}" | sha256sum)
+exec 9>"${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/command-palette-${UID}-${session_key%% *}.lock"
@@
-  --no-info) || exit 0
+  --no-info 9>&-) || exit 0
+
+# Only the menu owns the lock. Commands and their output may stay open long
+# after selection, and must not stop the next palette from opening.
+flock -u 9
+exec 9>&-

content.text: The shortcut is unblocked now. The old palette was waiting at “press any key to close,” so I dismissed it. The fix is in the repo; I’m checking that sessions stay independent and launched commands don’t retain the lock.

content.text:
Unblocked it. An old palette in another session was holding a global lock. Try **Ctrl+Shift+P** now.

Fixed the launcher to use per-session locks and release them before running commands. Checks pass; run `nswitch` to activate the permanent fix.
